event.surprise-bonus.text: Your manager calls you "a culture add" and hands over an envelope. Corporate says it is "one-time, not a precedent."
event.toxic-boss.text: Your boss schedules a 6 p.m. Friday "quick sync" to discuss "energy levels."
event.ai-pilot.text: HR announces "Project Synergy": an AI will "assist" with your job. You are asked to train it.
event.layoff-rumours.text: Someone saw a consultant with a clipboard. The group chat is on fire.
event.restructure-letter.text: An email titled "Exciting changes to our team" arrives at 4:59 p.m. on a Friday.
event.overtime-offer.text: The rota has a hole in it, and your name is written next to it in pencil.
event.employee-of-month.text: Your photo goes up by the break room. The prize is a branded water bottle.
event.tax-refund.text: The government owes you money. You check twice. It is real.
event.crypto-tip.text: A guy at the gym says $DOGEBANK is "definitely going to the moon this time."
event.phishing-text.click: Click the link, just in case
event.phishing-text.text: A text says your parcel needs a $2.99 redelivery fee. You are not expecting a parcel.
event.found-twenty.text: Last winter you left money in a coat. Past you is a hero.
event.bnpl-ad.text: An app offers a robot vacuum in "4 easy payments." The first one is free, technically.
event.market-dip.text: Your portfolio app is a sea of red. Influencers say "stay calm" in all caps.
event.side-sale.text: Your stuff could be someone else's vintage. ResaleIt says your old gadgets are "highly collectible."
event.friends-wedding.text: Save the date. The dress code is "elevated cottagecore." The gift registry starts at $80.
event.group-chat-plans.text: Someone suggests brunch. Nobody suggests a time. You could take charge.
event.breakup.rebound: Go out and dance it off
event.breakup.ice-cream: Ice cream and a sad playlist
event.breakup: It is not you, it is them
event.breakup.text: A situationship ends via a 47-message voice note.
event.stray-cat.text: A cat sits outside your door with the energy of a landlord.
event.family-call.text: Your mum asks if you are "still doing the computer thing."
event.neighbour-bbq.text: There is a BBQ two doors down, and you can smell it from here.
event.old-friend: An old friend is in town
event.old-friend.text: Your school friend is in town for one night only and wants "a proper catch-up."
event.flu.text: You have a fever, and the internet says it is either a cold or very bad.
event.marathon.text: A coworker is running a charity 5K and you said "maybe" in a moment of weakness.
event.back-pain.text: Your back makes a noise like a desk chair. It is the desk chair.
event.gym-trial.text: A gym offers a free week "with no obligation," then a 40-minute sales pitch.
event.mould: The mould has a name now
event.mould.text: There is a dark patch on the bathroom ceiling. Your roommate calls it Gerald.
event.roommate-drama.text: Someone ate your labelled leftovers. The label was in capital letters.
event.parents-chores.text: A laminated chore chart appears on the fridge, with your name on every row.
event.smart-condo-glitch.text: The smart lock is installing firmware. Estimated time: 3 hours. You are outside.
event.housewarming.text: Your friends insist on seeing the new place, and they are bringing a plant.
event.post-blows-up.text: Your rant about self-checkout machines has 2 million views, and brands are in your DMs.
event.cancelled.text: A 2019 tweet about pineapple pizza resurfaces, and the discourse is unkind.
event.meme-famous.text: A photo of you mid-sneeze is now a reaction GIF.
event.linkedin-guru.text: Your LinkedIn post "What my oat latte taught me about B2B sales" is doing numbers.
event.heatwave.ac-bill: Run the AC, pay the bill
event.heatwave.mall: Hide in the mall all day
event.heatwave.text: It is 38 °C, and your fan just makes the hot air move faster.
event.flood-warning.text: The street is a river. Your shoes are now boats.
event.power-cut.text: The grid takes a weekend off. So do you, apparently.
event.smoke-haze.text: The sky is orange. The air-quality app has run out of colours.
event.burnout.text: You hit empty. Your body files a formal complaint and books the weekend off without asking.
event.burnout-friends.text: Your friends turn up with snacks and confiscate your laptop. "For your own good."
news.ai-model-release: New AI model drops: "It writes better than you"
news.ai-model-release.text: A frontier lab ships a model that can do copywriting. Office jobs feel the draft.
news.warehouse-robots.text: Fulfillment centres roll out a new picking robot. It is called "Kevin."
news.rate-cut.text: Borrowing gets cheaper. So does saving, sadly.
news.rate-hike.text: Your savings earn more. Your credit card earns more too, from you.
news.housing-bubble.text: Rents surge as investors buy up everything with a door.
news.delivery-surge.text: Everyone orders in. GigHub pays a premium, for now.
news.gig-crackdown.text: GigHub responds by "optimising rider incentives." Pay dips.
news.hiring-boom.text: Companies are hiring again. LinkedIn is unbearable.
news.ai-bubble-mania.text: A toaster startup raises $40M for "AI toast." Markets are giddy.
news.market-panic.text: A bank you have never heard of collapses. Everyone has heard of it now.
news.grocery-shock.text: An egg now costs as much as an avocado used to. Prices spike across the board.
teaser.layoff: Your {{job}} badge might not work on Monday…
teaser.eviction-risk: LeaseLord sent a "friendly reminder" about the {{owed}} you owe. Miss one more rent and you are out.
teaser.collections-risk: Your {{debt}} is one missed payment from collections.
teaser.lease-renewal: Your landlord wants to talk about "market rates." Your lease renews next week at {{rent}} or more.
teaser.rival-close: {{rival}} is right behind you. Or is it in front?
teaser.promotion-close: Your manager keeps saying "big things are coming." A promotion to {{job}} is within reach.
teaser.credential-close: Only {{hours}} hours of study left until your {{course}} credential.
teaser.news: Breaking: {{news}}. Next week could get interesting.
teaser.gig-back: GigHub says your account is "under review." It ends this week.
teaser.next-week: {{rival}} posted "big week ahead 🚀". Of course they did.

event.porch-pirate.text: The doorbell camera you don't own would have caught them. Your new headphones are someone else's now.
